notes.title: [Beta] Ver 2.0.8b Changes on VCI
notes.notes:
Rooms
Changes

 To improve the stability of the server, we have applied limitations to some synchronization APIs in VCI.
 This is a counteraction against some VCIs that could overload the entire sync server and shut it down in the former sync systems. 
 We will be adjusting this limitation as we go as we want everyone to play VirtualCast comfortably.

 Here are the limitations in specific.
 APIs starting with _ALL_, such as _ALL_SetText, will have a sendable character limitation of 512 bytes (in UTF-8).
 This is about 500 alphabetical characters or about 250 Japanese characters.
 If you need to display a large number of texts, please use vci.state or vci.message API to synchronize.
 vci.message can send a text of up to 4000 bytes (in UTF-8).
 The amount of data you can share with vci.state is up to 16KB.

VCI

 Fixed the issue where the emission value of VCI items that use standard shader turned into a non-HDR value. 
 Fixed the issue where the color of VCI items using unlit shader becomes lighter.

Copy the code displayed on THE SEED ONLINE connection page, paste the code on the input field in VirtualCast and click [Next] to complete the steps.

New Features

 Released the Room feature.
 Currently the user interface is available in Japanese only. English localization is coming soon.
For details, see these articles(Japanese):
 VirtualCast wiki About Room
 Room: Quick Guide
 Room: Step-up Guide

 You can now specify the type of the controllers you are using in the settings screen(Only valid in the Room).
 The default is auto-detect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/cc4a3f8a375c17fea1a9b3878d14cb4910bcd601.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/47d144dc0c3e16d18e61501b4572f5fca9286c12.png

 Added HUD feature on the Room
 You can see your mic volume and current facial expression on the HUD when this feature is enabled
 For details, see [HUD Display].
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/b03faf46fe436c19acdf090119bbb528b25ceee3.png

 You can now purchase VRMs from the character context menu in the Room.
 Point the hand laser toward a character to open the character context menu. You can purchase the VRM from the context menu.
 Note, if the VRM's license limits the use of the avatar to "the author only," you can not purchase it in VR.
 A VRM can be purchased if it is merchandised in The Seed Online.

 Added block feature in the Room
 You can add a user to the block list from the Room page on the Web, the Participants list in the ring menu or the context menu opened by selecting a character.
 Added purchase history in the ring menu
 You can select items and characters purchased from within VR.
  Added Photo Capture in the Room
 This feature allows you to take photos in the Room and post it to Twitter
 For details, see How to operate in-Room camera(Currently in Japanese only)
[previewyoutube=Zck7LM5kRlE;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes

 From now on, press and hold the menu button while touching an item to open a context menu.
 This change is made to avoid the context menu from popping up unintendedly by pressing the menu button while an attachable VCI is attached near your hands. This allows you to open the ring menu anytime by just pressing the menu button shortly.
 Unified the naming convention of images exported from whiteboard to that of images exported from capture camera. 
 Changed the display speed of button texts and ticker messages in the ring menu.
 Changed the controller binding for Grip and Use on Index controllers.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][Before][/th]
        [th][After][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Press the trigger to Grip[/td]
        [td]Squeeze the controller to Grip[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Press A to Use[/td]
        [td]Press the trigger to Use[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]	
 Made an internal improvement on the rotation speed and locomotion speed settings.
You can now use VRMs "Authorized only to explicitly specified person" purchased in THE SEED ONLINE.
 Provided that the VRM is purchased on THE SEED ONLINE, you can use it as your avatar even when the VRM's license is set to "Authorized only to explicitly specified person."
 Fixed the error message that indicates the modification of lifespan is prohibited by the set privilege.
 When changing the lifespan of a VCI, you will be shown an error message if you do not have the privilege to execute that operation. The message has been reworded so that you can understand it more easily.

Improvements

 Changed the maximum length of the hand laser from 10m to 20m.
 Changed the laser shooting out of context menu to follow the object of interest.
 Optimized the ring menu to reduce the frame drop while manipulating it.
 When selecting a room on the ring menu, you can now see why you cannot enter a certain room (the room is full, you have no access right, etc.) before actually entering it.
 You will be notified when you couldn't enter the room because the room is full.
 The ReflectionProbe is now enabled in the Room
 This allows for rendering of accurate reflection on metallic materials in the Room
 You can now enable snapping of item rotation in the Room
 Snap toggle button is added in the context menu
 When the snap is enabled, the item will turn by 15 degrees while being grabbed
 Added a feature to load compressed textures when loading characters in the Room
 In the settings page, select [Graphics] > [Reduce memory usage for character rendering] to enable this feature
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/563d2b57f23afd4b3b98ebf49d4971c3ca5d0532.png
 This feature will compress the textures on character models to reduce memory consumption.
 Enabling this will reduce the memory usage, but it will lower the texture quality.
 You can now add a room to favorites from the context menu of a link object.
 Improved the download speed of THE SEED ONLINE items by compressing data.

 Fixed the issue where sometimes the "VCI LOADING" object kept existing even after the VCI is deleted.
 Fixed the issue where an image on the queue card was not visible from a certain angle when the opacity of the queue card is set to 100%.

【New Features】

To change the color, grab any pen to have the color of the pen copied to your fingers

【Bug fixes】

 Fixed the issue where a guest could destroy the external input monitor item when initialization fails on the guest's side
 Fixed the issue where the head of an avatar gets placed on the ground hight when gigantic avatar model is loaded

【VCI Changes】
 Camera FOV can now be controlled from VCI scripts
 For details, refer to this page.

Fixed the issue where different versions of a VCI is loaded between the room owner and the guest.
    After this fix, the version of VCI at the time of the initial load will continue to be loaded even after updating the VCI file on THE SEED. To load the latest VCI on THE SEED, delete the VCI in the room, and re-enter the room, then reload the VCI. You can also reload the VCI with the Reload feature in the context menu. 

About the voice system
【Studio 3D audio】
A new setting to change the studio audio to 3D is added to "Ring Menu" > [System] > [Studio settings] (Currently, this affects voice only)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/a05548708ff6c4d937e9276e90cb7e9fa338c7fe.png
 3D audio
 Add spacial audio effect to the sounds in the studio (Currently, this affects voice only)
 Voice Distance Rolloff
 When 3D audio is enabled, you can specify the distance at which sounds starts to get softer and the longest distance to which sounds can reach
 Min Distance: Sounds start to get softer from the specified distance (in meter)
 Max Distance: Specify the maximum distance that a sound can reach to (in meter)

【Voice settings】
New voice features are added with the renovation of the voice system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/0dabdf81c2b2b5400549b71467398017ef552dce.png

Audio pre-processor
Removes environment noise to make the sound cleaner
By enabling, you can use the following features
Reverb reducer
Removes reverberation (Room echo, etc.) from the input
Voice detection
A feature to detect your speech
It detects your speech and turns on/off the input accordingly
Auto gain adjustment
Automatically adjust the mic input to the appropriate volume
When the pre-processor is enabled, stationary noises such as wind blow from an air-conditioner or sound from a light source will be reduced
Echo canceller
Reduces residual echo
It also has the feature to reduce the volume of output while you are talking
